title: Track B — monitoring observation request (POST /v1/monitoring/observations)
description: Request body for the Track-B monitoring ingestion endpoint. This endpoint is monitoring-only: it never performs CAD inference and never returns a Track-A score (Phase 0 §R2-6.7, D-039). Monitoring observations are the only sanctioned route for wearable data, and wearable data may never be used as a CAD-inference input.

request_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. Informational only; idempotency is governed by the Idempotency-Key header.

source.description: Source of the observation. Unlike Track A, wearable sources are VALID here: monitoring ingestion is the only route by which wearable data may enter the platform (Phase 0 §F-4).

source_detail.description: Free-text provenance of the source (app version, adapter name). Informational only.

consent_id.description: Consent reference the observation is recorded under. Required by the semantic layer: a monitoring observation without a consent reference is rejected with 422 consent_required (Phase 0 §R2-6.7, F07).

metric_id.description: Identifier of a monitored quantity. The accepted identifiers, their units and their value ranges are listed in the MOCK_ONLY catalogue shared/contracts/registry/mock_monitoring_metrics.v1.json. An unknown identifier fails with 422 unknown_metric.

value.description: Measured value. A null value means 'not measured'.

unit.description: Unit of the measured value. A unit that does not match the catalogue entry fails with 422 unit_mismatch.

quality_note.description: Free-text note about measurement quality (e.g. motion artefact). Informational only.
